_doc: Per-segment export manifest a remote (vast.ai) grow box must emit; written as <seg>.export.json BESIDE the checkpoints (a NEW sidecar, D10: never modify meta.json/result.json/manifests). Every field below exists in the pipeline today (source in brackets); '!' = the remote does not get it for free and the wrapper must write it.

identity.seed_provenance: ! seed row id + seeder sha + coverage field level (seed.py)

inputs.prediction_md5_of_zarr_tree: ! md5 list of chunk files OR rsync --checksum log at stage-in

tool.release_sha: ! git rev-parse HEAD of the vpipe release that drove the run

rounds.peak_rss_mb: ! VmHWM sampled (attempt.peak_rss_mb is NULL for grow in the hub DB)
rounds.tree_md5: ! md5sum of every file shipped (maintenance.py line ~1195 convention: find . -type f ! -name '*.provenance.json' | sort | xargs md5sum)

ship: every r*/auto_grown_*  and guarded_g_*  directory (x/y/z/generations.tif, meta.json, guard.json)
do_not_ship: any credential, ssh key, hub token (hub.token), the prediction/CT/grids themselves
size: measured 4.8 MB for a 2-round PHerc0813 segment (fleet grow dir), ~0.5 MB per round-1 tifxyz; export per segment ~1-5 MB
hub_side_after_import: rescore verified_cm2 on the hub if the remote had no CT L0 (hub holds CT)
register attempt + metrics through the normal pipeline_db path (the remote never touches the hub DB)
